Home.metaTitle: Modulate — Evolve your business without disrupting everything
Home.metaDescription: Modulate combines strategy, design and technology to improve your digital presence and work systems.
Home.title: Evolve your business without disrupting everything.
Home.intro: Modulate combines strategy, design and technology to improve your digital presence and work systems.
Home.problemTitle: The company evolves. Its image, tools and workflows need to keep up.
Home.problemBody: Too much time spent on peripheral tasks, outdated systems, inefficient workflows, or an image that no longer reflects the company.
Home.improveImageBody: Digital presence, identity, design and websites fitted to how the company actually works.
Home.improveWorkBody: Workflows, automation, integrations and applications — where they solve a real problem.
Home.methodBody: Observe, listen, understand, question, identify, prioritize, build, improve. Sometimes the right recommendation is not to change what already works.
Home.workIntro: Every engagement starts from context. The cases below are placeholders until real projects are documented.

method.title: Method
method.body: We do not propose a solution before we understand the problem.

expertise.title: Expertise
expertise.body: Design, brand, development and automation — complementary, not piled up.

proximity.title: Proximity
proximity.body: Direct relationship, high standards and accessibility — not generic agency posture.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: We explain the reasoning and what should — or should not — change.

results.title: Results
results.body: More clarity, smoother flows, a more controlled image.

Home.ctaBody: Tell us about your situation. Together we will see what truly deserves to be improved.

Approach.metaDescription: We do not start with the solution. We start by understanding.
Approach.title: We do not start with the solution. We start by understanding.
Approach.intro: Every company is different. There is no universal solution. We start from your reality, identify what deserves improvement, then choose the right tool.

observe.title: Observe
observe.body: See how the company actually works.

listen.title: Listen
listen.body: Hear business stakes, not only technical requests.

understand.title: Understand
understand.body: Clarify the real problem before imagining the answer.

question.title: Question
question.body: Test assumptions and what seems obvious.

identify.title: Identify
identify.body: Spot what blocks, slows, or deserves to evolve.

prioritize.title: Prioritize
prioritize.body: Choose what has the most impact without opening everything at once.

build.title: Build
build.body: Deliver the right solution — design, site, system or automation.

improve.title: Improve
improve.body: Refine over time, without unnecessary disruption.

Approach.keepTitle: Sometimes the right recommendation is to leave things alone.
Approach.keepBody: If a system already works, we say so. Improving without unnecessary disruption is part of the method.

Expertise.metaDescription: Digital presence and systems & automation: two fields, one method.
Expertise.title: One method, two fields of work.
Expertise.intro: The diversity of capabilities is not a list of unrelated services. It follows from one method: understand the problem before choosing the solution.
Expertise.digitalTitle: Improve how the company presents itself.

systemsItems.ai: AI when it genuinely solves a problem

Expertise.entryBody: Templates and one-page sites for simple needs that do not justify a custom project. An access mechanism, not a discount position.
Expertise.aiNote: AI is a tool, not Modulate’s identity.
Expertise.ctaTitle: Not sure yet what should be improved?
Expertise.ctaBody: That is normal. Let’s start with a conversation.
